discovery.title: security(storage): bind SQLite observation to accepted host and actual Frank process
discovery.role: existing accepted-host plus actual-product-process read-only attestor; do not duplicate

mechanism: bind hostname and SHA-256 of /etc/machine-id to independently configured accepted-host identity
require exact loaded and active systemd unit
select exactly one expected executable inside the unit ControlGroup
bind stable PID start time and executable across observation window
bind stable mapped SQLite device/inode to one O_NOFOLLOW-opened same-FD hash
require trusted root-owned non-group/world-writable SQLite object and root runtime anchor
only then emit accepted-host selected-process SQLite-object match status
